data.body: **[P2] Flush spans ended during the provider wait.** With `BatchSpanProcessor`, an unawaited child can finish a step or context after `forceFlush()` captures its batch. Normal end hooks leave `externalCompletions.pending` empty, so this loop exits despite remaining budget; the final `endOpenSpans()` can also enqueue more spans. Lambda can then freeze with those spans still buffered. Track spans ended since each flush, close invocation state, and flush the final batch within the remaining deadline, as the execution view does. Extend the late-span regression with `BatchSpanProcessor` and assert delivery before provider shutdown.
